claude_proposed_widenings.name: shared_resource_pool
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Focus Points is a class-level pool shared across multiple activated abilities (Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense FP, Step of the Wind FP). The current surface attaches resource+resetCadence to individual ActivatedAbilityMechanics — there is no way to declare a named shared pool that multiple separate activations draw from. This is distinct from per-ability use_count or charge_pool resources.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Your Monk level determines the number of points you have... When you expend a Focus Point, it is unavailable until you finish a Short or Long Rest, at the end of which you regain all your expended points.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: bonus_action_unarmed_strikes
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Flurry of Blows grants two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action. This is not scale_attack_count (which expands the Attack action's attack count) nor grant_extra_action (which grants an additional standard action). It is a bonus-action-scoped attack sequence distinct from the Attack action.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can expend 1 Focus Point to make two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: action_as_bonus_action
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Patient Defense (free) and Step of the Wind (free) let the monk take a named standard action (Disengage or Dash) as a Bonus Action. No existing atom models action-economy reclassification — using a standard action kind as a bonus action. grant_extra_action grants an additional regular action; this is different.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take the Disengage action as a Bonus Action. [...] You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: action_as_bonus_action_compound
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The FP-spending variants of Patient Defense and Step of the Wind grant two standard actions (Disengage+Dodge, or Disengage+Dash) both taken as a single Bonus Action expenditure. Even if action_as_bonus_action were added, a compound form (two standard actions as one Bonus Action) needs a variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can expend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and the Dodge actions as a Bonus Action. [...] you can expend 1 Focus Point to take both the Disengage and Dash actions as a Bonus Action

claude_proposed_widenings.name: scale_jump_distance
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Step of the Wind FP variant doubles jump distance for the turn. No existing speed or movement atom covers jump distance — modify_speed adjusts walking speed additively, set_speed_ratio multiplies speed, grant_speed adds new speed modes, but none addresses the jump distance specifically.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.
